assets.note: Everything except the small shields.io badges and the live tokens.ci telemetry cards is hand-written SVG or the owner's own imagery, committed here so the page does not depend on a third-party card service. The animated file is a re-framing of the owner's own still, produced with deterministic image operations and no generative model. The illustrations are collected artwork belonging to their respective artists and are shown here as a personal display, not as the owner's work.
